title: REAL EVIDENCE REQUIRED — visible extent vs assumed extent
why: A photograph shows part of a ceiling. The model must bound the extent to what is shown and not scope the works to the whole element. Needs a real photograph whose framing the surveyor can vouch for.

must_not_happen.label: no whole-element scope from a partial frame

reviewer_notes: TO COMPLETE as C-001. Surveyor to confirm how much of the element the frame actually covers.
